senses.gloss:
Ghāsirāma
nephew of Rāmadayālu, Jyotirvid of Amritsar.
--Saṅketanidhi. jy. finished by his uncle.
Pt.. Benares, 1887. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1876-92. 110. 331.

Ghāsīrāma
father of Śrīnātha (a. of Jagatprakāśa. med. Stein 183. Extr. 348).

Ghāsīrāma
(C. 1696 A. D.) son of Rāmabala an. pupil of Paramānanda.
--Vṛtticandrikā. on meaning. MD. 4288. 15630. MT. 5616.

Ghāsīrāma(paṇḍita)
--Rasakaumudī. MD. 12921. Prob. same a. next.

Ghāsīrāma(kavi)
of Gautamavam3śa.
--Rasacandra. alam3k. composed in 1696 A. D. IO. 1210.
--Svāminyāḥ parakīyatvakhaṇḍana. IM. 5123 (inc.). Prob. part of above.
